summary: Build the cross-fish bilateral brain state matrix from zebrafish calcium imaging — load each larva''s 140-region left+right regional time series, apply a three-part symmetric exclusion rule (retina, zero-signal quality failures, bilateral pairing), detrend with a min-filter ΔF/F baseline, z-score each region over time, and concatenate all larvae along the time axis into a single (120, 19624) matrix.
use_when: Analyze bilateral cross-fish brain state matrix
Generate bilateral cross-fish brain state matrix outputs
avoid_when: The required input data contract is not satisfied
